name: Gigi il Guerriero
storyline:
After the fall of the Government, Italy plunged into an era of chaos. Political parties are now a distant memory, and their former Leaders clash in combat to claim the title of Emperor. The destiny of the beautiful country seemed already sealed. During the decisive battle between The Knight (Il Cavaliere) and the brave Gigi, the latter is mortally wounded and branded with 5 Stars, carved onto his chest by his opponent.

Abandoned on the desert soil of the city of Messina, Gigi is still breathing.

Then, an extraordinary event takes place: the former President of the Republic, sensing the honesty in Gigi's heart, saves his life and decides to become his master. Our hero is thus trained in the secret techniques of the 70 Years of the Italian Constitution. He will become the Last Savior, the messiah who will restore peace and honesty to the hearts of millions of Italians—Gigi the Warrior is born!
summary:
A satirical fighting game about Italian politics.

In a manner not too dissimilar from the work Hokuto no Ken (Fist of the North Star), Gigi the Warrior follows the deeds of a lone traveler, whose mission is to restore peace and honesty to an Italy devastated by the worst politics of recent decades.
